# datagecko_stream_charts (Resource)

A stream's declared charts, in order, replaced whole; the first is the hero. Destroying it returns the stream to its implicit chart. Declare one per stream: two on one stream overwrite each other on every apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# One datagecko_stream_charts per stream. Two on one stream overwrite each other on every apply.
resource "datagecko_stream_charts" "revenue" {
  stream_id = datagecko_stream.revenue.id

  chart {
    title = "Delivery vs baseline"
    series {
      id           = datagecko_series.delivery.id
      color        = "#f59e0b"
      width        = 2.5
      point_radius = 3
    }
    series {
      id    = datagecko_series.baseline.id
      color = "#64748b"
      dash  = "dashed"
    }
    marker { id = datagecko_series.deployed.id }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `stream_id` (String) The stream whose list this is. A change replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `chart` (Block List) One chart; at most 20 per stream. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--chart))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The stream id: the import identifier.

<a id="nestedblock--chart"></a>
### Nested Schema for `chart`

Optional:

- `marker` (Block List) A marker series shown on the chart. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--chart--marker))
- `series` (Block List) A measure series drawn on the chart, in order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--chart--series))
- `title` (String)

<a id="nestedblock--chart--marker"></a>
### Nested Schema for `chart.marker`

Required:

- `id` (String)

Optional:

- `color` (String) #rrggbb.


<a id="nestedblock--chart--series"></a>
### Nested Schema for `chart.series`

Required:

- `id` (String) A series of this stream.

Optional:

- `color` (String) #rrggbb.
- `dash` (String) solid, dashed or dotted.
- `fill` (Boolean)
- `point_radius` (Number) 0-8.
- `point_style` (String) circle, rect, triangle, cross or star.
- `width` (Number) 0-8.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By the stream's id: the list belongs to the stream.
terraform import datagecko_stream_charts.revenue 4f1c6a3e-...
```
